mechanism_narrative: A sustained slight rebound in RETAIL_REC over the last week, following a period of decline, indicates a nascent recovery in consumer activity that will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility increases week-on-week by more than 1 point, it signals a return to office-based work, which directly translates to increased foot traffic in nearby retail and recreation establishments within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the subsequent 2 weeks despite WORKPLACES rising by more than 1 point.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility and an increase in WORKPLACES mobility signifies a broader shift of people spending less time at home and more time in public, directly boosting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 4 weeks even if RESIDENTIAL decreases and WORKPLACES increases.

mechanism_narrative: As the decision time point is mid-October, the seasonal shift to colder weather will reduce outdoor PARKS activity, redirecting leisure spending and footfall towards indoor retail and recreation venues, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase, or PARKS mobility increases, during the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week increase in TRANSIT station activity by more than 1 point acts as a leading indicator for increased general mobility and economic activity, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the subsequent week despite TRANSIT rising by more than 1 point.

mechanism_narrative: Stable GROCERY_PHARM mobility combined with increasing WORKPLACES mobility suggests a return to routine and confidence in public spaces, encouraging discretionary spending and boosting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 4 weeks even if GROCERY_PHARM remains stable and WORKPLACES increases.

mechanism_narrative: The sustained low levels of RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT mobility, despite a minor recent uptick, indicate that underlying factors continue to suppress out-of-home activities, preventing a significant recovery and leading to RETAIL_REC remaining lower over the next four weeks compared to the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is significantly higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high RESIDENTIAL mobility coupled with consistently low WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicates a prevailing cautious sentiment among the population, which will continue to suppress discretionary out-of-home activities and drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 15% AND WORKPLACES remains below -15%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 4 weeks while RESIDENTIAL remains high and WORKPLACES/TRANSIT remain low.
